//: ABS validation: diagonal split-µ alternating-stripe pattern.
//1: Approximates real diagonal split-µ — at any instant during the
//2: brake event, one diagonal pair of wheels (FL+RR or FR+RL) is on
//3: asphalt and the other is on ice; the diagonal flips every wheelbase
//4: as the car drives forward.  See scripts/gen_diagonal_mu_level.py
//5: for the geometric construction and why a static diagonal pattern
//6: isn't expressible in chrono's flat-patch ground.
//8: Without ABS the BTCM has no chance — fronts lock at the same time,
//9: rears free-roll, and the car plows.  With per-wheel ABS the
//10: modulator can keep each wheel near peak slip on its current
//11: surface.  Headline metric: comparison of FL/FR/RL/RR slip patterns
//12: BTCM-on vs BTCM-off, plus yaw drift from the alternating split.
//15: level/flat_diagonal_mu.json: 112.5 m asphalt runway, then 250 m of
//16: alternating-diagonal stripes with 2.512 m period).  The runway is
//17: sized in scripts/gen_diagonal_mu_level.py, which generates that
//18: level file; edit the constant there and regenerate, never the JSON.
name: abs_diagonal_mu

events.//: Ease onto the pedal over ~0.75 s (not a step to full throttle —
events.//1: that spins the drive wheels from a dead stop; see the PR

events.//: Settle off the throttle on asphalt, coast onto the stripes, then
events.//1: brake -- the +6.5 s shift on both brake events (same 1.0, same 19 s
events.//2: hold) is what buys that settle.  A 6.00 s brake sat BEHIND the
events.//3: wait_for_speed barrier above, so it fired on the same tick the
events.//4: barrier released: full brake at the instant of throttle release.
